FAQ

How much does an AI receptionist cost for a plumbing business?Published entry prices in our directory run from $29/mo (Dialzara, 60 minutes) and $49/mo (Rosie, 250 minutes) up to $199/mo for unlimited calls (NextPhone, per a third-party report). Smith.ai has a free plan for 25 calls a month.
Which one is easiest to set up?Rosie lists 10–20 minutes and Dialzara 15–30 minutes. My AI Front Desk takes about 30–60 minutes.
What if I get a lot of emergency calls?Watch the minute caps. Rosie moves you up to the next plan ($149/mo for 1,000 minutes) instead of charging overage, My AI Front Desk charges about $0.25/min past 200 minutes, and NextPhone advertises unlimited calls.
